clips.title: Are You Relocating?
clips.movie: Planes, Trains and Automobiles / Cast Away
clips.quote: Bro are you going somewhere or relocating?
clips.description: For people carrying huge bags containing half their apartment, emotional baggage, and emergency supplies for the apocalypse.

clips.title: Corporate Slave Detected
clips.quote: Did you get the memo about the TPS reports?
clips.description: For work bags stuffed with laptops, random cables for nonexistent devices, anxiety, and unread Slack notifications.

clips.title: Respectfully... What Happened?
clips.quote: What happened to us last night?
clips.description: For plastic bags holding 47 crinkled receipts, loose pennies, mystery medicine, and untamed chaotic life choices.

clips.title: Entire Economy Inside
clips.description: For miniature handbags defying the laws of quantum physics with 14 products packed into 2 square inches.

clips.title: ₹300 Personality Trait
clips.quote: I'm not like other people, I carry books and matcha in cotton.
clips.description: For cloth tote bags carrying aesthetic sadness, 9 broken pens, organic snacks, and an unread novel.

clips.title: Fear of Responsibility
clips.quote: I am McLovin. I only carry what I can run away with.
clips.description: For crossbodies carrying exactly a phone, lip balm, and an acute phobia of commitments.

clips.title: The Portable Storage Unit
clips.quote: I have everything in here. Even things that haven't been invented yet.
clips.description: For backpacks equipped for a 3-week expedition to the Himalayas while just going to the local library.
